precepts.text: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly. He was a preacher of God's laws. That is what righteous means. His laws. So Noah was preaching to the people, and the people mocked him and laughed at him.
precepts.point: For in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

precepts.why:
Christ said “as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.” Noe is the Greek; it is still Noah. In his days they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, “until the day that Noe entered into the ark.” So what was Noah doing all that time? Peter tells us.

God “spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly.” Noah was a preacher of righteousness: a preacher of God's laws, because that is what righteous means, his laws. He was warning the people to repent and change their ways, and the people mocked him and laughed at him.

Then they “knew not until the flood came, and took them all away.” Took them away into what? Not the kingdom of heaven: destruction, death. Took is the past tense of take. So when Christ says “the one shall be taken, and the other left”, the one taken is taken to destruction, like the ungodly in the flood, and the one left is the righteous, like Noah.

So it shall be at Christ's coming: nations eating and drinking and carrying on, while those preaching God's laws are mocked, until the destruction comes on the world of the ungodly. “Therefore be ye also ready.”

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

precepts.why:
Christ said “Watch therefore” and “Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.” Brothers and sisters, we have to be ready. Ezra gives the Lord's word to those who are: “Hear, O ye my beloved, saith the Lord: behold, the days of trouble are at hand, but I will deliver you from the same.”

The days of trouble are at hand, but the Lord will deliver his beloved from them. “Be ye not afraid neither doubt; for God is your guide, And the guide of them who keep my commandments and precepts, saith the Lord God: let not your sins weigh you down, and let not your iniquities lift up themselves.” God is the guide of those who keep his commandments and precepts; they are the ones left when the others are taken to destruction.

This is the same thing Noah was preaching back then, but nobody listened; everybody mocked him. The message is the same now: keep the commandments, don't let your sins weigh you down, and be ready, because the day comes in an hour you think not.

precepts.text: Whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning. After reading what Christ said, we are going back historically regarding brothers becoming betrayers.
precepts.point: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another. Christ prophesied brothers becoming betrayers; that is today's lesson.
precepts.why:
Christ prophesied it: “And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.” Brothers becoming betrayers. Paul shows where to look to understand it: “For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” So after reading what Christ said, we go back historically to what was written aforetime about brothers who became betrayers.

The history is in 2 Maccabees 3. The holy city was at peace “and the laws were kept very well, because of the godliness of Onias the high priest, and his hatred of wickedness.” Because of Onias' faith, his strength and love for God's laws, everybody else was inspired, and even the kings honoured the place and magnified the temple with their best gifts. That is the mentality we all must have: “Ye that love the Lord, hate evil.” You don't hate evil as long as you watch pornography at home.

“But one Simon of the tribe of Benjamin, who was made governor of the temple, fell out with the high priest about disorder in the city.” Onias had the last say; Simon did not agree. “And when he could not overcome Onias, he gat him to Apollonius”, governor of Celosyria and Phenice, up by Damascus. He ran to the other nations against his own brother, “And told him that the treasury in Jerusalem was full of infinite sums of money.” You don't want to do what I say? I'm going to tell the other nations about all the money in the temple. You can't make this stuff up. That money was for the Levites, the strangers, the fatherless and the widows.

Ecclesiasticus names that kind of man: “there is a friend, which is only a friend in name. Is it not a grief unto death, when a companion and friend is turned to an enemy?” He rejoices with you in prosperity, “but in the time of trouble will be against him.” It is the same with those who leave the truth today: “I hate the work of them that turn aside.” It was written for our learning, so that we can see the betrayer Christ spoke of coming and not be moved.

precepts.text: He shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds. The elect is Israel, the only people scattered from one end of heaven to the other.

note.label: 70 Times 7: The Perfection of Mercy Through Christ

precepts.why:

Christ says: “And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.” The trumpet sounds at his coming, and it gathers his elect.

The elect is only Israel, not all nations. They are gathered “from one end of heaven to the other” because we were scattered from one end of heaven to the other. That tells you who the children of God are: the only people scattered from one end of the earth to the other are the so-called blacks and Hispanics, the Israelites.

So the feast of trumpets looks forward to that great sound, when Christ sends his angels to gather his scattered people home.

precepts.text: For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel mine elect. The elect are not anybody that worships; the elect is Israel.
precepts.point: He shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other. People say the people in the land of Israel today are the Jews. That is not what the Bible says. After the tribulation, when the stars fall (the missiles) and the powers of the heavens are shaken (nations warring against each other), “he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.” Notice the angels do not go to one land to gather this people. Christ is letting us know the Israelites would not be in a land; they would be scattered worldwide.

Who is the elect? Some say anybody who worships. Isaiah says: “For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect”. That is the elect: Israel, scattered in the four winds from one end of heaven to the other.

Before the angels come for them, the Lord calls to the heavens and to the earth: “Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.” The saints are “the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel”, and only the Israelites made a covenant with God by sacrifice. The call to the heavens is to the angels; the call to the earth is to us.

So the message for us on earth is the same as the angels' commandment: gather the saints. We are not supposed to be looking for other races and nationalities, only the twelve tribes of Israel, scattered worldwide, which is why the gospel has to go out to every land.

precepts.text: Declaring the end from the beginning: there was a council with the Father before time, his counsel shall stand and cannot be thrown off track, and this destruction is his pleasure even if it is not yet yours.

“Saying, My counsel shall stand”. God's counsel and his will shall be done. You cannot move it around, thwart it, or throw it off track. Whether you believe it or not, prophecy will be fulfilled; the word of the Lord will not go out void.

precepts.why:

That is why we are not fearful of freedom. Every bomb dropped and every war fought is loosening the links of the shackles of our captivity. The Lord is the director of this thing, and those he chose out of poverty are the heirs of the kingdom.

precepts.text: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to new gods that came newly up. The white Jesus is a new god, created during the Renaissance. Islam is a new god, created around 600 AD after Christ. Those are the new gods our people went after.

precepts.text: Behold the word of the Lord, receive it: believe not the gods of whom the Lord spake.
precepts.point: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be. When he comes it is going to be like lightning; he is not going to be in any secret chambers.
precepts.why:
“Behold, the word of the Lord, receive it: believe not the gods of whom the Lord spake.” Receive it means believe it. Receive the word of the Lord, and do not believe these false gods out here.

precepts.text: Four angels hold the four winds, the armies on land, sea and air, until the servants of God are sealed in their foreheads; the seal is the law bound among the disciples, not the hexagram, and the sealed are the 144,000 of all the tribes of the children of Israel.

precepts.why:
“And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.” Earlier Christ said in Matthew 10, “Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.” So we are not going to reach all the Israelites. Then what does “all the world” mean, and when does the end come? Revelation 7 answers.

“I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth”. That is the fighting, the wars. “That the wind should not blow on the earth”: the armies. “Nor on the sea”: the marines and the navies. “Nor on any tree”: what is above the trees is the air force.

“And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God”. The seal of the living God is not the hexagram. It is the law: “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” He cried to the four angels “to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea”, hurt it with destruction: “Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.”

“And there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.” So the end begins when the 144,000 are sealed. The world Christ is talking about in Matthew 24 is the 144,000: when they are sealed, then shall the end come.

precepts.text: A multitude out of number gathered from the four winds to subdue the man that came out of the sea: the armies coming against the Son of God.
precepts.point: He that endures to the end shall be saved. This gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness, and then shall the end come: that world is the 144,000, and when they are sealed the end comes.
precepts.why:
Revelation 7 has four angels holding the four winds of the earth. Let the Bible say what the wind is. Write it down: “And after this I beheld, and, lo, there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea”.

Where did the multitude come from? From the four winds of heaven. And what did they come for? To subdue the man that came out of the sea. So the winds are their armies coming against the Son of God, coming against the master.

That is why the four angels hold the winds so they do not blow on the earth, the sea or any tree: the armies on land, the navies and marines on the sea, and the air force above the trees. The destruction is held back until the servants of God are sealed. When the 144,000 are sealed, the winds are let go, the nations gather for war, and after that tribulation the Son of man comes in the clouds of heaven.

precepts.text: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples: the seal of the living God.
precepts.point: He that endures to the end shall be saved. This gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness, and then shall the end come: that world is the 144,000, and when they are sealed the end comes.
precepts.why:
In Revelation 7 another angel ascends from the east “having the seal of the living God”, and the destruction is held back “till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.” What is the seal of the living God?

It is not the hexagram. Many of us thought so years ago when we were young. Isaiah says what it is: “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” The seal of the living God is the law, bound up and sealed among his disciples. Pay attention, because if you blink you might miss it.

So the servants sealed in their foreheads are the ones with the law of God in their minds: “an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.” When they are sealed, the four winds are loosed and the end comes. That is why this gospel, the law and the testimony, has to be preached in all the world for a witness: to seal the 144,000 before the end.

precepts.text: I will send those that escape of them, the 144,000, to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Tubal, Javan and the isles afar off that have not heard my fame, and they bring all your brethren out of all nations to the holy mountain Jerusalem, already established, and some are taken for priests and Levites: that is the gospel preached in all the world.
precepts.point: He that endures to the end shall be saved. This gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness, and then shall the end come: that world is the 144,000, and when they are sealed the end comes.
precepts.why:
Remember, the 144,000 have to be sealed, and then the end comes. Isaiah shows what they do: “And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations”. Those that escape are the 144,000. He sends them “to Tarshish”, Spain; “Pul”, Libya; “and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal”, Turkey; “and Javan”, the Grecian islands; “to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory”.

There will be people who have not heard the fame of the Lord and have not seen his glory: Israelites who have not heard or seen anything, and we have to go get them. “And they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.” That is “this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations”.

You might think that is talking about now. The next verse clears it up: “And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the Lord out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem”. Jerusalem is already established as holy. Is Jerusalem holy today? No, there are bombs and missiles going off there. So this is not now; the kingdom is already set up.

“And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, saith the Lord.” The brothers gathered from among those nations, the Lord will make them priests and Levites. With that, Matthew 24:14 gives a deeper understanding: the gospel preached in all the world is the work of the 144,000, and once they are sealed, the end comes.

precepts.text: The host of heaven dissolved and the heavens rolled together as a scroll, the mushroom effect; my sword shall be bathed in heaven and come down upon Idumea, the so-called white man who leads the planet, and upon the people of my curse. Christ comes back for war, not only to save.
precepts.point: All the tribes of the earth mourn and he sends his angels to gather his elect from the four winds: the elect is Jacob and Israel, not the Baptist church nor all races, and some Israelites who never heard still have to be fetched.
precepts.why:
“Immediately after the tribulation of those days”: the churches argue about a seven-year dispensation, pre-trib and post-trib, and say the church is not going through tribulation. They do not know the Bible. Those who are alive must and will go through tribulation. Then “the stars shall fall from heaven”: missiles, rockets. “And the powers of the heavens shall be shaken”: that is war. Notice it says heavens, plural; it is not talking about the sky. What powers of the heavens?

Isaiah shows it: “And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll”, the mushroom effect. “And all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree”: missiles and rockets falling.

“For my sword shall be bathed in heaven”. Christ said his sword would be bathed in heaven, so what heaven is he going to bathe his sword in? “Behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.” Idumea is the so-called white man, the leading race on the planet. The powers of the heavens shaken is the war with Idumea, all these Edomite nations.

So Christ comes back for war, not only to save. The order is tribulation, then war between the nations, then the sign of the Son of man. The gap may be five years, as World War II was once America entered, or seven; it does not say.

precepts.text: For Jacob my servant's sake and Israel mine elect: we are the elect.
precepts.point: All the tribes of the earth mourn and he sends his angels to gather his elect from the four winds: the elect is Jacob and Israel, not the Baptist church nor all races, and some Israelites who never heard still have to be fetched.
precepts.why:
“And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.” Who is the elect? Not everybody.

Isaiah says: “For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect”. We are the elect. Israel is the elect. Not the Baptist church, and not all races on the planet.

And it is from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other, because Isaiah 66 already showed there are Israelites scattered in the isles afar off who have not heard his fame nor seen his glory, and we have to go get them.

Before that gathering, “then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn”. It is going to be a happy day, but we will be crying and fearful too. And it comes only after the tribulation. Christ is not returning this year or next year; bad things have to happen first and we have to be proven. Not being able to pay your light bill is not tribulation. We are too comfortable, still smoking weed, going to the club, defiling the Sabbath, the women dressed like hoes with no clothes; in their affliction they will seek him, and the affliction has not even begun.

precepts.text: Signs in the sun, moon and stars, eclipses and blood moons, distress of nations with perplexity, the sea roaring and men's hearts failing for fear: we are in verse 25 going into 26, and when these begin, look up, for your redemption draweth nigh, so clean yourselves up now.
precepts.point: All the tribes of the earth mourn and he sends his angels to gather his elect from the four winds: the elect is Jacob and Israel, not the Baptist church nor all races, and some Israelites who never heard still have to be fetched.
precepts.why:
Luke tells the same coming, and shows where we are in it. “And there shall be signs in the sun”, like a solar eclipse, “and in the moon”, blood moons and lunar eclipses, “and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations”: we are seeing that now. “With perplexity”: perplexity means confusion. “The sea and the waves roaring”: the nations roaring.

“Men’s hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.” That is war. “And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.” Right now we are in verse 25 going into the top part of verse 26.

“And when these things begin to come to pass”: the signs in the sun, the moon and the stars, the distress of nations with perplexity. “Then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.” We are supposed to be looking up and lifting up our heads, knowing redemption is soon to come.

But we know the order of what is going to happen: tribulation, war, then Christ. So this is our time to clean ourselves up and get right with the Lord, because the time is drawing close.

precepts.text: The Lord comes with fire and chariots like a whirlwind to plead with all flesh, and the slain of the Lord shall be many: not just Esau, the wicked Israelites too.
precepts.point: All the tribes of the earth mourn and he sends his angels to gather his elect from the four winds: the elect is Jacob and Israel, not the Baptist church nor all races, and some Israelites who never heard still have to be fetched.
precepts.why:
When Christ comes after the tribulation and the war, he does not come only to gather; he comes to judge. Isaiah shows it: “For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.”

“For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.” All flesh. The slain of the Lord shall be many, and that is not just Esau. The wicked Israelites too.

That is why Christ is not coming tomorrow to rapture a comfortable church out of trouble. He comes with fire and sword against the nations of Idumea, and against every wicked one, including our own people who keep smoking, clubbing, and defiling the Sabbath. The powers of the heavens are shaken, his sword is bathed in heaven, and only his elect, Jacob and Israel who repented and endured, are gathered from the four winds.

precepts.text: For Jacob my servant's sake and Israel mine elect. The elect gathered from the four winds are the twelve tribes.
precepts.point: He shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet and gather his elect from the four winds. Israel is his elect.
precepts.why:
Christ says that after the tribulation of those days, when the stars fall from heaven (the missiles the prophets saw) and the powers of the heavens are shaken, “he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.” Who is the elect?

Isaiah answers: “For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect”. Israel is the elect. The elect gathered from the four winds are the twelve tribes of Israel, scattered to the ends of the earth.

And notice when it happens. He comes in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory after the tribulation and the war. There is no thought that he might come tomorrow; the tribulation has not come yet, and World War III is already in process. First the war and the shaking of Idumea, the powers of the heavens; then the sign of the Son of man, all the tribes of the earth mourning, and the gathering of Jacob's seed, Israel his elect, out of every nation where they were scattered.

precepts.text: When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, then shall they dwell in the land I gave to my servant Jacob. So what is Netanyahu talking about? The gathering is God's, from among the nations, and it is also the answer when someone brings up Revelation 7:9 on the street.
precepts.point: He shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet and gather his elect from the four winds. Israel is his elect.
precepts.why:
Christ said the angels “shall gather together his elect from the four winds”. Ezekiel shows who does the gathering and from where: “Thus saith the Lord God; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered”.

When who? The Lord God. The house of Israel is gathered from among the people where they are scattered: from the nations, from the four winds. So what is Netanyahu talking about? What are the not-so-Israelis over there talking about? The gathering is God's, and it is out of the nations, not a state set up by men.

“And shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.” Only when God has gathered them do they dwell in the land he gave to Jacob.

That is also the answer when someone on the street brings up Revelation 7:9 and the great multitude out of all nations: it is the house of Israel, gathered from among the people where they were scattered, the elect of Isaiah 45, “Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect”.

precepts.text: Four angels hold the four winds, destruction, that they blow not on the earth (the armies), the sea (the navy), nor any tree (the air force), until another angel with the seal of the living God, which is the law of Isaiah 8:16, has sealed the servants of God: 144,000 of all the tribes of the children of Israel. Once they are sealed, the end comes, destruction upon destruction.
precepts.point: When ye see the abomination of desolation spoken of by Daniel stand in the holy place. Christ called the white man that, and the same people are in the land today.
precepts.why:
“And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.” Some say that contradicts Isaiah 66, where the Lord gathers his people out of the nations. It does not. The world Christ speaks of here goes into the 144,000, and Revelation 7 shows it.

“I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.” The four winds are destruction. The earth is the armies on land; the sea is the navy and the marines; any tree is the air force, which comes down above the trees.

“And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God”. The seal of the living God is the law: “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” That is what the angel is looking for.

Verse three is the point that ties in with Matthew 24: “Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.” Do not let the destruction come until the servants of God are sealed. “And there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.”

Once the 144,000 are sealed, then shall the end come: destruction upon destruction upon destruction. And because the 144,000 are scattered among the nations, the gospel must be preached among all the nations. That is why we must go out and prophesy and teach among all these different nations: our people are there.

precepts.text: A multitude of men out of number gathered from the four winds of heaven to subdue the man that came out of the sea. The nations gather to fight Christ, which is Daniel 8:25, standing up against the Prince of princes and broken without hand.
precepts.point: When ye see the abomination of desolation spoken of by Daniel stand in the holy place. Christ called the white man that, and the same people are in the land today.
precepts.why:
Revelation 7 shows four angels holding back the four winds of the earth. What is the wind? Ezra gives the precept: “And after this I beheld, and, lo, there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea”.

A multitude of men out of number, coming from the four winds of heaven. The winds are the armies of the nations gathering, and the destruction they bring. They come “to subdue the man that came out of the sea”: to subdue Christ. They want to fight Christ, the Son of God.

That goes back to Daniel 8:25, where they stand up against the Prince of princes, but he is broken without hand. It is saying the same thing.

So when the angels hold the four winds so that they blow not on the earth, the sea or any tree, they are holding back the armies of the nations, on land, on sea and in the air, until the servants of God are sealed. Then the winds are let loose, the nations gather to fight Christ at his coming, and the end comes.

precepts.text: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples. That is the seal of the living God the angel is looking for.
precepts.point: When ye see the abomination of desolation spoken of by Daniel stand in the holy place. Christ called the white man that, and the same people are in the land today.
precepts.why:
In Revelation 7 another angel ascends from the east “having the seal of the living God”, and he cries to the four angels, “Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.” What is the seal of the living God?

Isaiah answers: “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” The seal is the law, the commandments. That is what the angel is looking for, and that is what he is doing: sealing the law among the disciples, the servants of God, in their foreheads, meaning in their minds.

The ones sealed are “an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.” When they are sealed with the law, the destruction is let loose and the end comes.

So the gospel of the kingdom preached in all the world for a witness is the law and the testimony going out to our people scattered among the nations, sealing them before the end. He that endures to the end, keeping it, the same shall be saved.

precepts.text: Immediately after the tribulation of those days, the stars, missiles, fall from heaven and the powers of the heavens, the European nations, are shaken with war; and then the sign of the Son of man, and he sends his angels to gather his elect, Israel, Isaiah 45:4, not Baptists, Pentecostals, Muslims, or Catholics. Isaiah 34:4-5 shows the heaven that is dissolved and rolled together like a scroll, nuclear bombs, with the host falling like leaves and satellites dropping: my sword shall be bathed in heaven and come down upon Idumea, the Greek and Roman name for Edom, America, France, Germany, Britain, Russia.
precepts.point: The fear of the Lord is all wisdom, Sirach 19:20, and in all wisdom is the performance of the law: be about it, not just talk about it. If you do not fear the Lord, that is where your problems are.
precepts.why:
Christ says it himself: “Immediately after the tribulation of those days.” People say there is no tribulation; there is going to be tribulation. Then “shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light”, as Luke read, “and the stars shall fall from heaven”: missiles. “and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken”: America, Britain, Germany, France, Russia, Canada, Spain, all those European nations, shaken with war.

How do we know the heavens are those nations? Isaiah 34: “And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine”: bombs, nuclear bombs, missiles and satellites dropping out of the sky. “For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea.” Idumea is the Greek and Roman name for Edom: America, France, Germany, Britain, Russia. That is heaven.

“And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven.” After the tribulation there is still war; so don't say there's war, we're going home tomorrow. Where is the great tribulation, Jacob's trouble?

“And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds.” He is not gathering everybody, only the elect: “For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect.” The elect are the Israelites, not Baptists, Pentecostals, Muslims or Catholics. That is our hope amid destruction.

precepts.text: The nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, carried as the wind, and the Carmanians, Iran, shall go forth as wild boars and join battle with them and waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians. That is unity and nukes, and neither is present yet. What you are seeing is contractions.
precepts.point: All these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet. Nation against nation, famines, pestilences, earthquakes: the food shortages, COVID, and the brethren the Lord received are the beginning of sorrows. Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted and kill you; Jacob's trouble is not here yet, though it can escalate quickly on the Lord's timeline.

note.label: Marriage Beyond Romance: From Eden to Modern Confusion

precepts.why:
Christ said “ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled”, and “the end is not yet”. Ezra shows what the end involves, and it is not here yet.

“Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.” That is the Arabs, Ishmael, the wild men.

“Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood”: the Carmanians are Iran. “And with great power shall they come, and join battle with them”: join battle with the Arab nations. “And shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians”, over on that side of the earth.

When it says waste a portion, it is dealing with nukes, and it is dealing with unity: Iran and the Arab nations together. Right now neither of those things is present. So what you are seeing is contractions. It is extremely significant and we should not sleep on it, but it is the beginning of sorrows.

That is why we are not troubled. We do not sleep as others do; like a team moving ten yards at a time down the field, we see ourselves moving toward the goal every time these things happen. It should only trouble you if you are not in the right spirit to move with urgency and repent.

precepts.text: Except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved. Shortened means events accelerate, like a woman in travail: each contraction inches closer. The stage is being set, and the Lord can put spirit on men to move things along quicker.
precepts.point: All these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet. Nation against nation, famines, pestilences, earthquakes: the food shortages, COVID, and the brethren the Lord received are the beginning of sorrows. Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted and kill you; Jacob's trouble is not here yet, though it can escalate quickly on the Lord's timeline.

note.label: Marriage Beyond Romance: From Eden to Modern Confusion

precepts.why:
“And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.” Things are going to get so crazy in the earth that the Lord has to move events forward. Shortened means events will accelerate.

That is what the similitude of a woman in travail goes into: there are times of contraction, then a time of relief from it. But never forget that every contraction means you are being inched closer, moved another ten yards down the field. It is an acceleration of events, just as the prophets described.

So what we are actually witnessing is the stage being set. Do not think what is happening over there is insignificant by any measure. For Iran and the Arabs to be united the way the prophecy says, certain steps have to happen, and it may seem far off; but the Lord can put spirit on men to move things along quicker, shortening the days and increasing the speed of those events.

Christ did not give dates and times, because much depends on when we are sealed, when the 144,000 and the other pieces are in place. Prophecy is not meant to entertain us; it is meant to correct us. The more signs we see, the more urgently we should be repenting, correcting our lives and strengthening our households to prepare for those days. “Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you”: Jacob's trouble is not here yet, but it can escalate quickly on the Lord's timeline.

precepts.text: The day shall come that they which dwell upon earth shall be taken in a great number, billions in the third woe; the way of truth, who the Israelites are, shall be hidden; the land shall be barren of faith, and iniquity increased above that which now thou seest. The land that thou seest now to have root shalt thou see wasted suddenly: the land of Israel, by the Persians and the Arabs, the waster of Isaiah 54:16. If the Most High grant thee to live, thou shalt see after the third trumpet that the sun shall suddenly shine again in the night, a nuclear bomb at night, and the moon thrice in the day, three bombs by day at Ekron, Ashdod, and Ashkelon. And blood shall drop out of wood.
precepts.point: And the stars shall fall from heaven: the prophets saw intercontinental ballistic missiles and nuclear weapons falling, Iran shooting missiles, and the powers of the heavens shaken. Then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven, and all the tribes of the earth shall mourn and see him coming. Christ comes in the midst of the third war, right behind the stars hitting Babylon; that is why Job says we laugh at destruction.

note.label: The Real Reason Iran Was Attacked

precepts.why:
Christ said the sun would be darkened and the stars would fall from heaven before the sign of the Son of man appears. Ezra shows the same end, and it goes into the land of Israel and those who call themselves Jews and are not being destroyed.

“The days shall come, that they which dwell upon earth shall be taken in a great number”. That is the third woe: billions of people are going to die. “And the way of truth shall be hidden”: who the Israelites are, who the people of that land are, is hidden. “And the land shall be barren of faith. But iniquity shall be increased above that which now thou seest, or that thou hast heard long ago.” You see how wicked this world is getting; that was prophesied.

“And the land, that thou seest now to have root, shalt thou see wasted suddenly.” The land that has root now is the land of Israel, and it will be destroyed suddenly by the Persians and the Arabs. That goes back to the destruction at noonday. Wasted is the word Isaiah uses: “I have created the waster to destroy.” Seeing the land wasted means nuclear bombs.

“But if the most High grant thee to live, thou shalt see after the third trumpet”: in Revelation the third trump is nuclear war. “That the sun shall suddenly shine again in the night”: a nuclear bomb going off at night looks like the sun shining. That is what the prophet saw. “And the moon thrice in the day”: three bombs going off in the day, at Ekron, Ashdod and Ashkelon. “And blood shall drop out of wood”.

That is why Iran was attacked: they are trying to stop prophecy, or slow it down. But God's counsel shall stand. Iran will develop nuclear warheads, the Arabs will unite, and they will be brought down in the valley of Jehoshaphat. The day of the Lord will not come on us as a thief, because we are watching the signs.

precepts.text: Learn a parable of the fig tree: when his branch is tender and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh; so likewise, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors. The destruction is at the doors, and here we are playing games.
precepts.point: We set up programs to protect you, sisters and brothers, because we have a vantage point over you: you are upset you cannot move as fast as you want, but the brother is not ready to prove that sister and the sister needs to work on herself. Fathers see the landscape of the whole congregation and can tell when a brother is not in his right mind while the daughter sees only that he is cute. Lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.

note.label: The Vantage Point of the Elders: the Fathers Have Spoken

precepts.why:
“Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh”. Christ is saying, pay attention to the seasons. Watch the fig tree; when the branches are tender and the leaves come out, you know summer is near by how the trees are changing.

“So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.” We do not know the day and we do not know the hour, but we know we are in the season. The prophets wrote down what was coming, and now we actually see it: the missiles sitting in the silos ready to rock, the mushroom cloud Isaiah 34 speaks of. They did not have that when Malachi brought this out, but it is here now, letting us know what time we are in. You are not going to get a bigger sign than that.

So that is where we are: the destruction is even at the doors, and here we are playing games. That is what Malachi was saying: “lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.” Smite the earth with destruction. So we had better remember the law of Moses, the laws and the commandments, and keep them, so that we are not caught off guard when that day comes. Knowing these things are coming, our minds and our spirits need to be right.

precepts.text: Dinah was not raped. She went out to see the daughters of the land on her own, away from her father and twelve brothers who surely brought the wisdom pertaining to a woman to her; if thy daughter be shameless, keep her in straitly. Shechem saw she was not rolling in the spirit of her fathers and took her, and his soul clave unto her, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel. That is the part: you gave him your ear, he got your underwear. She was enticed, beguiled, allured away from her protection. Slick brothers read your spirit when you are not studying and hit you in the DM. Her brothers said you are not keeping her, so she had to live with the stain; you read nothing of her after that.
precepts.point: Whoremongering brothers come in, fake the funk, become soldiers, and slip into the sisters' DMs. That is why we tell you to exchange medical records and check for what needs checking when you correctly come together; we do not need to see them, you show each other. These brothers look for spinsters, sisters with the anxieties of getting too old and not being married yet, and gas them up; all bread is sweet to a whoremonger.

note.label: The Vantage Point of the Elders: the Fathers Have Spoken

precepts.why:
Christ says, “except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.” We claim we want the days shortened, but we are not ready, because wicked brothers are trying to slide in. Brothers and sisters who come from the world with a world mentality would love nothing more than to seduce and defile you, men and women both, because they don't want to change. Negroes don't like change. They pretend they've changed and put on the fringes and the border of blue so you let your guard down, then work behind the scenes to allure you away from your protection.

Dinah shows how it happens, and she was not raped. “And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.” Was she snatched? No, she went out on her own. With a father and twelve mighty brothers, you know they brought her the wisdom that pertains to a woman, and tried to keep her in straitly, the way the scripture says to keep a shameless daughter. She did not want to hear it. She wandered away from her father and her brethren.

“And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.” Something in her spirit let him know. He knew whose daughter she was, and he saw she was not rolling in the spirit of her fathers or her brethren. That is how slick brothers hit sisters in the DMs: they read your spirit when you are not studying, and once they talk that talk, you feed right into it.

“And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.” That is the part that tells you it was not rape: he spake kindly to her. You gave him your ear, he got your underwear. She was enticed, beguiled, allured: drawn away from her protection, from her fathers, from how she was raised, from the protections leadership put around her. Enticing is covetousness; she belonged to Jacob, and he drew her away. Then he asked to marry her, and her brothers said no, you already defiled her. She had to live with that stain for wandering out of her father’s care, and you read nothing of her after that.

Christ warns, “there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect”: some of you men and women of the third slated to make it. Everybody with fringes and a border of blue is not right; do not look at his pretty beard. One who tells women marriage is not the goal and singleness is not the curse, while flaunting his own wife, is the devil in black flesh; he wants the women to stay in sin. A woman in the world turned down one of these street preachers when he broke character to ask for her number.
